findings.title: Redis cache with non-SSL port enabled
findings.description: azurerm_redis_cache with enable_non_ssl_port = true accepts plaintext Redis connections, exposing credentials and data in transit.
findings.remediation: Enforce TLS 1.2+. Set `min_tls_version = "TLS1_2"` / `minimum_tls_version = "1.2"`, replace HTTP listeners with HTTPS, and redirect HTTP→HTTPS. Disable weak ciphers and old protocol versions.
